text:
mike: uploaded an NSYS capture from a repro run, p99 spike on microbatches. link: https://internal-storage/nsys/2213344556.trace
perf-bot: nsys capture available at /captures/2213344556.trace (indexed)
nora: quick skim of the timeline — lots of H2D memcpy bursts on stream 2 right before compute on stream 0, but overlap looks minimal. copy engine busy then compute stalls.
kevin: raw numbers: memcpy ~700-900us in many spots, kernels ~150-250us. copy engine appears serialized with compute at peaks. possible fallback to synchronous copy?
ashley: stack: batcher -> prefetch -> kvcache_prefetch_worker. We call cudaMemcpyAsync into a pinned-pool normally. If pinned alloc fails we fall back to pageable -> cuMemcpyHtoD synchronous. Also seeing ~2-3ms CPU gaps in the host thread around the same times.
mike: here's the NVTX span we add around prefetch (excerpt):
```
NVTX_PUSH("prefetch:kv:seq=...");
cudaMemcpyAsync(dst, src, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream);
NVTX_POP();
```
nora: the capture shows the host thread calling `cuMemcpyHtoD_v2` at some points (stack visible in host samples). when that happens we lose overlap.
kevin: hypothesis: small, frequent copies + occasional pinned allocator miss + host thread preemption -> synchronous H2D -> compute waits. That matches the timeline where compute gaps line up with host gaps.
ashley: another angle: kernel selection heuristic — for tiny microbatches we sometimes pick the 'wide' matmul kernel which runs shorter but requires different workspace; combined with the copy pattern it magnifies the interleaving. can we log selected kernel in traces?
mike: agree. proposed quick tests: (1) enable a preallocated pinned-slab allocator to eliminate failover to pageable, (2) add NVTX around select_kernel() and record selected kernel name, (3) raise host worker thread priority on test nodes to reduce preemptions.
perf-bot: experiment results (local): baseline p99=132ms, pinned-slab enabled p99=98ms, median also improved. nsight timeline shows fewer `cuMemcpyHtoD_v2` host-blocking events.
nora: nice. next: add NVTX tags for kernel selection and compare two captures. also collect `/proc/interrupts` and SCHED info to rule out IRQ storms.
kevin: action items: 1) ashley to open PR for pinned-slab allocator behind feature flag, 2) add NVTX around select_kernel() + include kernel-name metadata in trace, 3) run nsys on dedicated test node with rtprio bumped, 4) collect post-change capture and diff.
ashley: I'll draft the PR and include a small microbenchmark that toggles allocator path. will also add a tiny test that simulates worker preemption by sleeping between alloc and enqueue. pinging infra for rtprio slot.
mike: thanks everyone — saving capture id 2213344556 and notes here. we'll reconvene after one validated repro with NVTX+slab. :thumbsup:
